learned.title: The timing test is decided: a day early wins on shares
learned.note: Four weeks, 27 dated posts a side. A day early was shared 9 times, day-of 6, and led three weeks of four (1 to 2, then 3 to 2, 4 to 2, 1 to 0). Median reach is equal at 32. Not two-to-one, but the better side on the number that carries the reach, so from Wednesday every dated post goes out the day before.

moves.title: Every dated post goes out a day early
moves.why: The test is over: a day early was shared 9 of 27 times, day-of 6 of 27, ahead three weeks of four. The share is the reach.
moves.plan: From Wed Nov 25 every dated post goes out 24 hours before its old slot, same hour, so the venue and the act have a day to reshare. Four weeks of the half-and-half test: a day early was shared 9 of 27 times, day-of 6 of 27, ahead three weeks of four. Say don't and the half-and-half split keeps running.

moves.title: The venue is invited onto its post
moves.why: Every post was tagged this week and one was shared. A tag sits in the venue's tagged tab; an invite asks them to put it on their grid.
moves.plan: From Wed Nov 25 every story post invites its venue as a collaborator, beside the tag it already carries. If the venue accepts, the post sits on its own grid in front of its followers; if not, nothing changes. This week every post was tagged and one was shared; a tag is seen and not acted on. Say don't and the posts stay tagged only.

moves.title: Touring acts get looked up by name
moves.why: Its first week: ten of seventeen posts tagged an act, up from seven. The one shared post, yeEDM, was shared by its promoter.
moves.plan: From the Tuesday Nov 17 research pass, when a venue's post names no handle for an act, the research opens the act's own Instagram profile by name and tags it. Big Something is @bigsomething, 27,600 followers, followed by The 808, and Friday's post reached 275 without them. Say don't and the gate stays as it is.
